Name: Asahel
Summary: Asahel, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was swift of foot as a wild roe. He chased Abner alone at Gibeon and would not turn aside, so Abner killed him with the hinder end of his spear, and Joab never forgave it.
KeyStory: Asahel's speed carried him alone after Abner — and Abner killed him for it.
RelatedPeople: Zeruiah; Joab; Abishai; Abner, Son of Ner; Jonathan, Son of Asahel
LifeLesson: Speed without wisdom runs alone into a spear.
